title: Brick Workout Combined TSS Leaderboard
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brick:workout bike_run_combo_tss=*
| stats sum(bike_run_combo_tss) as total_value, avg(bike_run_combo_tss) as avg_value by race_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks target race values by total and average combined tss across brick workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bike_run_combo_tss` values for each brick workout event and review total and average combined tss by target race.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total combined tss.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which target race shows the biggest combined tss numbers in your brick workout data.
